conclusion: Two independent readers checked the defining article, all six 2025 publisher attachments, the Datlinger indexing predecessor, Hennig Tn5 article and File S1, both candidate 10x guides, and the later Nature Protocols preview and supplementary PDF. Original MOESM3 Table 1 prints modified general oligos and 96-member ATAC/RNA pre-index families; Table 13 contains distinct perturbation constructs. Hennig's 5′-phosphorylated MErev lacks SUM's published 3′ ddC termination and is not substituted for it. The later protocol confirms a reverse-complement ATAC sample-index example and read parsing but does not establish the 2025 experiment's 10x kit revision. Picelli 2014a original, full later article and its XLSX tables, author pipeline contents, and a version-matched 2025 10x guide remain open. No residual missing-information claim is accepted.
